comparisonConvention: Unshifted soma voltage at every retained 0.025 ms frame including conditioned frame 0; identical 10 micrometre maximum compartment length, 0.00125 ms timestep, 100 ms settling, 20 ms observation, 34 C model and homogeneous 0.3 S/m conductor. Soma event is an upward -25 mV crossing with 2 ms refractory.

import json,subprocess,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from importlib.machinery import SourceFileLoader
ROOT=Path('/workspace/scratch/84d15317573f/buildthesimulation')
wrapper=SourceFileLoader('native_position_reference',str(ROOT/'scripts/cortex-reliability-neuron-reference.py')).load_module()
reference=wrapper.reference
reference.ROOT=Path('/tmp/cortex-native-position')
(reference.ROOT/'tests/fixtures').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
raw=subprocess.check_output(['node','--input-type=module','-'],cwd=ROOT,input=b'''import {freshActiveConfig} from './src/lib/cortex/config.js';import {makeWorld} from './src/lib/cortex/world.js';
const cases=[42,43].map(r=>{const c=freshActiveConfig();c.neuron.somaUm=[0,0,1500];c.neuron.segmentLengthUm=10;c.solver.dtMs=.00125;c.solver.durationMs=20;c.solver.sampleMs=.025;c.protocol.mode='extracellular-stimulation';c.protocol.amplitudeUa=40;c.protocol.sourceContactIds=['r4-c4','r4-c5'];c.recording.contactIds=['r3-c3','r3-c6'];const w=makeWorld(c);return{id:'position-'+r,config:w.config,nodes:w.neuron.nodes,stimulatingSites:[{positionUm:[0,-r,1500]},{positionUm:[0,1000,1500]}],recordingSites:w.config.recording.contactIds.map(id=>w.contacts.find(s=>s.id===id))}});console.log(JSON.stringify(cases));''')
inputs=json.loads(raw)
results=[]
for c in inputs:
 audit=wrapper.audit_geometry(c)
 r=reference.run(c)
 r['geometryAudit']=audit
 r['stimulatingSites']=c['stimulatingSites']
 results.append(r)
 (reference.ROOT/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scriptSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'inputSha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'cases':results},separators=(',',':')))
 print(c['id'],r['spikeTimesMs'],max(r['somaVoltageMv']),flush=True)
